description: Source code for the disk cache file handling class 'File' in the Chromium project, implementing file I/O operations with asynchronous support.

classes.name: disk_cache::File
classes.description: A class managing file I/O operations with support for asynchronous read/write and file length management.

methods.name: File::Init
methods.description: Initializes the file with the given file path.

methods.name: File::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the underlying file handle is valid.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the file at a specified offset into a buffer.

methods.name: File::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the file at a specified offset from a buffer.

methods.name: File::Read (overload with callback)
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read with callback support.

methods.name: File::Write (overload with callback)
methods.description: Performs asynchronous write with callback support.

methods.name: File::SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file.

methods.name: File::GetLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of the file.

methods.name: File::WaitForPendingIOForTesting
methods.description: Waits for all pending I/O operations to complete, used in testing.

methods.name: File::DropPendingIO
methods.description: Drops any pending I/O operations, static method.

methods.name: File::DoRead
methods.description: Performs the actual read operation on a worker thread.

methods.name: File::DoWrite
methods.description: Performs the actual write operation on a worker thread.

methods.name: File::OnOperationComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of asynchronous I/O.
